question: Which additional goddess-powers are to be included in the worship sequence?
premises: Phalguni is named as an object of worship.
Jhintirilli and the fifth are also named.
The mantra-garland is included in the same sequence.
inference: These named powers are to be worshipped together as part of the prescribed arrangement.
uncertainties: The exact identity of Jhintirilli is unclear from this verse alone.
plain_english: One should worship Phalguni, Jhintirilli, the fifth goddess, and the mantra-garland.
